CustomField.description: Username or user ID of the person or service account that initiated the deployment. Published by: deployment tooling or CI/CD pipeline. Consumed by: SmokeTestOrchestratorTrigger to populate InitiatedBy__c on SmokeTestExecution__c for audit trail. Expected format: Salesforce username (user@domain.com) or 18-character User ID.
CustomField.label: Deployed By
